Release Notes

E.X. Release 17.11

E.X.1. Migration to Version 17.11

E.X.2. Changes

  • Fix memory-safety bugs in processing of incorrect ispell/hunspell dictionary files (Heikki Linnakangas) §

    Discovered while fuzzing.

  • Fix crash with namespace nodes in contrib/xml2's xpath_nodeset() function (Andrey Chernyy, Michael Paquier) §

  • In contrib/ltree, fix integer overflow in comparisons (Ayush Tiwari) §

  • When a partition's detached partition is DETACH FINALIZE, fix a logical replication regression (Tomas Vondra) §

  • Fix several typos in the documentation

  • Fix unexpected subxact cache search-path for HOT-pruned tuples (no commit URL, no name)
